name: Continuous Stochastic Solids Volume Rendering
definition: A rendering technique treating Gaussian primitives as continuous stochastic solids, replacing standard 3DGS rasterization to improve geometric accuracy and depth synthesis quality by allowing transmittance to vary continuously.
summary: Continuous Stochastic Solids Volume Rendering improves geometric accuracy and depth synthesis by treating Gaussian primitives as continuous stochastic solids, replacing standard rasterization to eliminate floating-depth artifacts.
